definitions.gloss: to make stand out, to highlight, to accentuate
definitions.explanation: To cause something to become more prominent, noticeable, or distinctive. The causative form of {際立|きわだ}つ (to stand out).

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{際立|きわだ}たせて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The red accessory makes the outfit stand out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{照明|しょうめい}→照明：03243_shoumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{際立|きわだ}たせて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The lighting was accentuating the beauty of the artwork.

examples.japanese: ⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{際立|きわだ}たせる⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A white background has the effect of making the text color stand out.

notes:
FORMS:
Causative form of ⟦{際立|きわだ}つ→際立つ：07832_kiwadatsu⟧ (to stand out, to be conspicuous). ⟦{際立|きわだ}つ→際立つ：07832_kiwadatsu⟧ → {際立|きわだ}たせる.

USAGE:
Common in contexts related to design, fashion, art, and presentation. The subject is usually something that enhances or highlights another thing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧: to set off, to make look better
- ⟦{強調|きょうちょう}する→強調する：21684_kyouchousuru⟧: to emphasize (more direct)
- ⟦{目立|めだ}たせる→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: to make conspicuous

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{際立|きわだ}たせる: to make one's individuality stand out
- ⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{際立|きわだ}たせる: to highlight the charm
- ⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{際立|きわだ}たせる: to accentuate the difference
